dialogues.speaker: Biao
dialogues.text: Long was the road, and treacherous the way, as we guarded our client... Many trials and tribulations did we endure. Are you mad at me for only returning to see you now?

dialogues.speaker: Mei
dialogues.text: How could I be? I just...

dialogues.speaker: Mei
dialogues.text: "As clouds by morning, as rain by night, I dwell ever in the mountain's sight." Though we could not meet, I thought of you every single day we were apart.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: Huh... Oh, it's you. What brings you here?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Oh, {F#s}he was just saying that we haven't been to Wanmin Restaurant in a while, but we've got time today, so we decided to swing by for some lunch! Um, is Chef Mao not in today?

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: He's out buying some ingredients, so I'm looking after the store today.

choices.text: You were in deep thought just a moment ago...

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: No, it's fine now.

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: What would you like to eat? I can make it for you — I've learned a few things from Chef Mao while working here.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ooh, really? What can you cook, then?

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: Hmm. There's Grilled Tiger Fish, Jueyun Chili Chicken...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Awesome, those are all some of our favorites!

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: Yes, I've noticed you ordered them during previous visits.

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: Just wait a moment. Leave the cooking to me.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: We'll help you out.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's right! Paimon, the Great Gourmand and taster of countless delicacies, is here to give you some tips today.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Let's go!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Whoa, the veggies got chopped in a heartbeat — that's {NICKNAME} for you!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh, hang on, isn't the flame a bit too high— Hey, hey, Shenhe! Smoke's pouring out from beneath the stove!

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: No need to worry. Cryo incarnate!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...Wait, why'd you freeze over the stove too!?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm... Huh? This tastes... surprisingly good.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: The chili chicken's taken on a whole new texture after being flash frozen. Have we... discovered a new dish by accident?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Mmm, delicious! Hehe, come try some, you two!

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: I'm glad it tastes good. Let's cook together again sometime.

response.speaker: Wangfa
response.text: Hello there, are you open for business right now?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, looks like more customers are starting to show up. Guess you should get back to work, Shenhe.

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: Yes. I'll go have a look.

response.speaker: Wangfa
response.text: "Sunset Red Tours"? You sure a name like that will bring in clients?

response.speaker: Decai
response.text: Oh, come on. We can work on the name later. What I'm telling you is that "sending your elderly family out on tours" is a thing youngsters do to show their filial piety nowadays, so they say. It's a business opportunity not to be missed!

response.speaker: Decai
response.text: ...Sorry, could we order, please?
